@kertal could you confirm that this is an existing bug for searchable snapshots, possibly since we introduced `include_empty_fields`? The same bug now affects verified read-only indices as well as they through a similar path.

is there an easy way to mitigate this in Kibana by disabling `include_empty_fields` ?

> [@kertal](https://github.com/kertal) could you confirm that this is an existing bug for searchable snapshots, possibly since we introduced `include_empty_fields`? The same bug now affects verified read-only indices as well as they through a similar path.

do we have an 8.x instance available with searchable snapshots? I'm not aware of this.
 
> is there an easy way to mitigate this in Kibana by disabling `include_empty_fields` ?

Sadly, no. We rely in Discover on the results of the `include_empty_fields=false` to distinguish available from not available fields

issue.body:
Load field caps from store if they haven't been initialised through a refresh yet.
Keep the plain reads to not mess with performance characteristics too much on the good path but protect against confusing races when loading field infos now (that probably should have been ordered stores in the first place but this was safe due to other locks/volatiles on the refresh path).

Closes #125483
